cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(XML1DSP LANGUAGES C)
add_library(xml1-dsp STATIC dsp.c dsp_c.c dsp_dma.c interp/dsp_cpu.c interp/debug.c)
target_include_directories(xml1-dsp PUBLIC . PRIVATE compat)
target_compile_features(xml1-dsp PRIVATE c_std_11)
target_compile_definitions(xml1-dsp PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(xml1-dsp PRIVATE /W3 /UNDEBUG)
endif()
add_executable(dsp-core-test ../../tests/dsp_core_test.c)
target_link_libraries(dsp-core-test PRIVATE xml1-dsp)
